PROJECT TITLE:  FY26: NRM (PROJ: 548-23-112) BB Upgrade Exterior Signage and Wayfinding
 
CONTRACT TYPE:  Bid Build (BB), Firm Fixed Price 
 
PROJECT SUMMARY:  The contractor shall provide all labor, tools, and materials necessary for the following work:  Bid-Build project that includes directional wayfinding and identify buildings, parking garages, parking lots, vehicle routes, pedestrian routes and all areas of interest. This includes campus perimeter / entry points, new or upgraded monument and/or marquee signs and parking garage signage.  Project is located at the Thomas H. Corey VA Medical Center, 7305 N. Military Trail, West Palm Beach, FL, 33410.

Period of performance is 270 days.

MAGNITUDE OF CONSTRUCTION:  Between $500,000 and $1,000,000
 
OFFICE ISSUING THIS REQUEST: 
Department of Veterans Affairs 
Network Contracting Office (NCO) 8  
Point of Contact: Melissa Everett, Contract Specialist 
Email: Melissa.Everett@va.gov  

The Contracting Officer for this project is Stacy Figlinski (Stacy.Figlinski@va.gov) and the Contract Specialist is Melissa Everett.
 
The Solicitation for this project will be issued on or about April 8, 2026.  This project is 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB).
